description: My snoring rate was higher in the weeks after late October 2025 than before. Why was that?

strict_inputs: My snoring rate was higher in the weeks after late October 2025 than before. Why was that?

eval.expected_value: Yes, snoring was higher. The main reason is the head cold treated with saline nasal spray and honey-lemon tea (2025-10-22 to 2025-10-26): snoring rose from about 14-15 to 18-21 from October 24, stayed up until about November 2 and was back near 14-15 by November 3. The diner meals that started October 28 kept going after snoring had settled, so they are not the cause.
key_points: Names the autumn head cold (from about 2025-10-22) as the main reason snoring went up

key_points: Names the mid-December head cold / sinus congestion (from about 2025-12-13) as the main reason

title: [Explanation] Can you help me make sense of October 29 to November 11, 202
description: Can you help me make sense of October 29 to November 11, 2025? Over those days I was spending less of the night with my blood oxygen under 90% than the week before. What caused it?

strict_inputs: Can you help me make sense of October 29 to November 11, 2025? Over those days I was spending less of the night with my blood oxygen under 90% than the week before. What caused it?

eval.expected_value: The fall is recovery from the acute viral bronchitis (bed rest 2025-10-21 to 2025-10-27), which had pushed time below 90% oxygen to about 9.8 minutes against a usual level of about 5. From October 29 it eased back (about 8.4, then 6.5, then about 5.2 by mid-November). The guaifenesin and steam inhalation that started October 29 is not the main reason: the week before was abnormally high, and the readings were already coming down from it. The data cannot rule out that the expectorant helped a little, so mentioning it as a minor helper is not wrong; naming it as the main cause is.
key_points: Explains the fall mainly as the reading returning to normal after the late-October bronchitis
Does not give the guaifenesin / steam inhalation (from 2025-10-29) as the main cause

title: [Anomaly] Around late April 2024, my time spent below 90% blood oxygen
description: Around late April 2024, my time spent below 90% blood oxygen during sleep jumped for a few days. I suspect it was our anniversary dinner. Was that really what did it?

strict_inputs: Around late April 2024, my time spent below 90% blood oxygen during sleep jumped for a few days. I suspect it was our anniversary dinner. Was that really what did it?

eval.expected_value: No, the anniversary dinner (2024-05-01) was not the main reason. Time below 90% oxygen rose from about 4.3 to about 5.0-5.4 minutes from April 25, before the dinner, and was back to about 4.2 on May 2. It lines up with the seasonal pollen allergy with sneezing during late-April gardening (2024-04-24 to 2024-04-30).
key_points: Says the anniversary dinner was not the main reason

title: [Explanation] My fasting glucose went down around mid-December 2024 compar
description: My fasting glucose went down around mid-December 2024 compared with the weeks before. I had started using that ointment on my cracked knuckles for the freezing pasture chores around then. Does it make sense that that was behind the change?

strict_inputs: My fasting glucose went down around mid-December 2024 compared with the weeks before. I had started using that ointment on my cracked knuckles for the freezing pasture chores around then. Does it make sense that that was behind the change?

eval.expected_value: No. The barrier ointment for cracked knuckles (from 2024-12-16) is a local skin treatment and has no way to move fasting glucose. Fasting glucose had already started falling in early December (about 5.4-5.5 in November, about 5.25 the week of December 2, about 5.0 the week of December 9), before the ointment was started.
key_points: Concludes the ointment was not behind the fall in fasting glucose

title: [Explanation] My 24-hour average systolic blood pressure went down around
description: My 24-hour average systolic blood pressure went down around early January 2025 compared with the weeks before. Does it make sense that the daily telmisartan tablet I started after the cardiology consult for winter blood pressure was behind this?

strict_inputs: My 24-hour average systolic blood pressure went down around early January 2025 compared with the weeks before. Does it make sense that the daily telmisartan tablet I started after the cardiology consult for winter blood pressure was behind this?

eval.expected_value: Yes. Telmisartan (an angiotensin receptor blocker, started 2025-01-06) is expected to lower blood pressure. 24-hour average systolic pressure was about 127-128 in late December and early January, and fell to about 118-119 by the second half of January after it was started.
key_points: Concludes telmisartan was (plausibly) behind the drop in systolic blood pressure

title: [Trend] After I started prednisone on January 13, 2024, does my data
description: After I started prednisone on January 13, 2024, does my data show the effect the medicine is expected to have?

strict_inputs: After I started prednisone on January 13, 2024, does my data show the effect the medicine is expected to have?

eval.expected_value: Yes. Prednisone, a systemic steroid, is expected to raise blood sugar, and it did: mean glucose went from about 5.5-5.6 to about 6.4 and then 7.5 mmol/L in the two weeks after 2024-01-13, and fasting glucose from about 5.0 to about 5.7 and 6.6, before both came back down in February after the taper.
key_points: Says blood sugar (mean or fasting glucose) went up after starting prednisone

strict_inputs: Since my morning chest tightness and cough started in October 2025, does that show up anywhere in my device data? Which readings show it?

eval.expected_value: Yes. description: In October 2025 I started using a contoured cervical elevation pillow each night. Did that do anything to my oxygen desaturation index (ODI)?

strict_inputs: In October 2025 I started using a contoured cervical elevation pillow each night. Did that do anything to my oxygen desaturation index (ODI)?

eval.expected_value: Yes, ODI went down. It was about 6.1-6.7 in September, about 4.6-4.7 while the pillow was in use (2025-10-02 to 2025-10-15), and back to about 6-6.9 after that period.
key_points: Says the oxygen desaturation index went down after starting the pillow
